body: Lil Yachty tried on Cuffem’s glasses and immediately started acting just like him Soon as the frames went on, Boat started dropping Cuffem’s iconic lines like he’d been waiting for his chance to do the impression. If you’ve watched enough Cuffem clips, you probably knew exactly what he was about to say before he even said it At this point, somebody needs to hand Cuffem a pair of Boat’s glasses and let him return the favor Via:.
